authoritative_scope: one accepted canonical [t0,t1] candidate interval; downstream cumulative reporting is outside persistent column state

true_only_when: accepted transaction route explicitly marks external flux accounting authoritative for every accepted segment
accepted transaction route explicitly marks start and end persistent physical storage authoritative
all active physical water stores and external water fluxes required by the concrete model are included exactly once
all published aggregate terms are finite
kernel result provenance is bound to the originating committed lineage/revision and requested interval
completeness.inactive_optional_physics: does not create a missing contribution merely by being absent/inactive
completeness.active_unaccounted_physics: must set complete=false and a nonzero compact missing-contribution mask

missing_contribution_mask.production_state_overhead: none; carried only in per-result accounting

reserved_generic_bits.4: accepted external flux accounting not authoritative
reserved_generic_bits.8: active physical contribution missing or model reports incomplete accounting

missing_contribution_mask.future_extension: additional model-specific bits may be registered without changing kernel aggregation; kernel treats mask opaquely except for generic reserved bits

storage_ownership.included: persistent physical water storage that survives accepted interval boundaries
examples: macropore water when active and accounted
storage_ownership.default_storage_accounting: fail-closed until the concrete transaction model explicitly certifies storage completeness

flux_ownership.canonical_boundary: aggregate external inflow and external outflow totals
flux_ownership.detailed_terms: may remain adapter/model-specific; aggregate totals must include every active external contribution exactly once
flux_ownership.internal_transfer_rule: internal component-to-component transfers are not added to canonical external totals
flux_ownership.normalization: model/adapter may normalize existing physical sign conventions into non-negative total_in and total_out; mapping must be source-bound and tested

transaction_semantics.trial: may produce candidate mass accounting only
transaction_semantics.rejected_trial: must not populate accepted mass fields or mutate committed state/accounting
transaction_semantics.retry: accepted mass terms are taken only from the finally accepted route; rejected-attempt terms are discarded and never accumulated
transaction_semantics.canonical_substep_commit: transaction_result exposes authoritative accounting only for TX_STATUS_ACCEPTED
transaction_semantics.kernel_candidate: stores the same full-interval mass accounting as kernel_result together with lineage/revision/[t0,t1] provenance
transaction_semantics.kernel_commit: successful explicit commit may return exactly the candidate accounting once; failed/stale commit returns no accepted accounting
transaction_semantics.rollback: discarding a candidate does not mutate committed state and does not create cumulative accounting

generic_time.definition: mass accounting belongs exactly to requested [t0,t1] and remains unchanged for subdaily, non-midnight and cross-midnight intervals

scientific_policy.hard_failure: structurally incomplete or non-finite authoritative accounting remains complete=false

fmr04_target.profile: corrected B1.10 default MvG, swkimpl=0, swmacro=0, root extraction inactive, snow inactive, admitted top provider/source-sink/bottom boundary
fmr04_target.expected_downstream_change_after_fkt08: F-MR04 bridge explicitly marks its already calculated storage and external flux contributions authoritative; then the same physical fixture can require kernel_result.mass.complete=true
